verdict.rationale: Kit's broadcasts API lets a developer create and update broadcast email content as HTML, and the broadcast record references an email template. Custom-field keys act as personalization tags in broadcasts and sequences, so HTML content with variable substitution can be pushed from code. However, there is no documented API for managing reusable email templates, no MJML support, and no version-control or sync workflow. missing for 10: API endpoints to create/update reusable email templates, MJML support, documented templates-as-code/version-control workflow, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage email templates as code — HTML/MJML or API-managed templates with variable substitution — under version control
